title: Anyone here using AI or Autonomous investing tools?
author: Maleficent_Home_7440
selftext:
Does anyone here use an investing app they actually like for more automated or autonomous investing?

I’m especially curious about tools that help with monitoring strategies, finding opportunities, or automating parts of the process without just handing everything over to an advisor.

I’ve been looking at a few different options recently and would be interested to hear what people here are using and what you like or dislike about them.

comments.author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
comments.body:
I do and made the platform out of it.

The idea was LLM alone can't complete the whole workflow. There are 4 different parts of workflow I was dealing with. 

Charts: trading view  
Execution: TWS  
Analysis: Claude  
Automation Strategies: VSCode 

So I clubbed everything into single platform with Python coding workspace and SDK along with AI Assistant with all the context you could ask for your trading workflow.

You can checkout it here: https://while25.com

replies.author: demure_bot
replies.body: People would want to see a GitHub repo. Basic security principles.
